scheme_name: Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats
other_conditions: Applicant must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry for at least five continuous years at the time of applying
Applicant must be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must not be a recipient of Old Age Pension issued by the department
Applicant must not be employed in Government, Government Undertakings, or the Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must have no dues payable to the Department or Fishermen Co‑operative Societies at the time of application
Applicant must possess a registered mechanized boat
Applicant must have carried out overhauling/repairs to the engine or hull during the notified fishing ban period and must not have fished during that ban period
benefits_summary: A financial grant of ₹10,000 per registered wooden/steel mechanized boat or ₹5,000 per registered fiber‑reinforced plastic mechanized boat for reactivation.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
